name: active_selections
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL relies upon the concept of an active selection.

name: alignment_as_cylinders
summary: If true, distance measure dashes are drawn as high-quality cylinders instead of lines.

name: all_states
summary: controls whether or not all molecular states are visible.

name: ambient
summary: (float 0.0-1.0, default: 0.14) controls the ambient lighting level.

name: ambient_occlusion_mode
summary: Controls which method is used to draw ambient occlusion. 0=disabled, 1=atom-based occlusion, 2=triangle-based occlusion

name: ambient_occlusion_scale
summary: The scale by which ambient occlusion values are modified. The larger this value the more hinting is applied.

name: ambient_occlusion_smooth
summary: Controls whether or not ambient occlusion uses smoothing of nearby values.

name: anaglyph_mode
summary: implements the following 4 anaglyph modes (see also Anaglyph stereo mode settings) 0 = true anaglyph 1 = gray 2 = color 3 = half-color 4 = optimized (default)

name: angle_color
summary: Controls the coloring of angle measures.

name: angle_label_position
summary: (float: >0.0, default: 0.5) controls where the angle label is drawn.

name: angle_size
summary: (float: >0.0, default: 0.6666) controls how far out the angle indicator is drawn.

name: animation
summary: controls whether or not the camera is smoothly interpolated between views.

name: animation_duration
summary: controls the default duration of animation for changes in view (note: scene_animation_duration controls the timing of scene transitions.

name: antialias
summary: (integer 0-4, default: 1) general settings for controlling antialiasing. 0 = no antialiasing 1 = adaptive antialiasing 2 = 2-times uniform oversampling plus adaptive antialiasing 3 = 3-times unifor...

name: antialias_shader
summary: Real-time (shader) antialiasing: 0 none, 1 FXAA, 2 SMAA.

name: assembly
summary: For loading mmCIF files: Read assembly (biological unit) instead of asymmetric unit

name: async_builds
summary: controls whether or not geometry builds should be performed in parallel on multithreaded machines. WARNING: This setting can create instability and should be used with caution.

name: ati_bugs
summary: Controls whether or not PyMOL adapts its rendering to avoid known ATI bugs.

name: atom_name_wildcard
summary: controls the wildcard character used when matching atom names. If this string is empty, then the normal wildcard setting will be used. The practical purpose of this setting is to disable use of ast...

name: atom_type_format
summary: Sets the label format for label types. Supported options are: mol2, sybyl, macromodel, mmd, sdf. mol2 sybyl (synonym for mol2) macromodel mmd (synonym for macromodel) sdf (default)

name: auto_classify_atoms
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL spends extra CPU cycles classifying atoms as polymer, organic, solvent, or inorganic as well as locating per-residue guide atoms.

name: auto_color
summary: controls whether or not new objects are given a different color for their carbon atoms.

name: auto_color_next
summary: Index of the next auto color to be assigned by auto_color.

name: auto_copy_images
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL automatically copies images from the OpenGL viewport into the system's clipboard.

name: auto_defer_atom_count
summary: Structures with fewer than ''auto_defer_atom_count'' atoms are automatically labeled upon loading. Set to 0 to auto label none.

name: auto_defer_builds
summary: Multistate models with fewer than ''auto_defer_builds'' number of states will automatically be preprocessed for geometry and rendering. Set to -1 to process all states regardless of count.

name: auto_dss
summary: controls whether or not secondary structure is automatically computed for structure which lack such definitions.

name: auto_hide_selections
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL automatically disables selections when new objects or selections are created.

name: auto_indicate_flags
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL automatically indicates flagged atoms when the \flag\" command is issue."

name: auto_number_selections
summary: controls whether PyMOL gives each new unnamed selection a unique name or whether it simply uses \sele\"."

name: auto_overlay
summary: controls whether or not overlay text is automatically shown/hidden in response to user actions.

name: auto_remove_hydrogens
summary: controls whether or not hydrogens are automatically removed when building.

name: auto_rename_duplicate_objects
summary: if on, PyMOL will rename new objects that have the same name as an existing object; if off, PyMOL will overwrite the existing object.

name: auto_sculpt
summary: controls whether or not sculpting is automatically activated when an atom is moved.

name: auto_show_classified
summary: How newly classified atoms are shown: -1 auto, 0 off, 1 as, 2 show, 3 simple.

name: auto_show_lines
summary: controls whether or not the lines representation is automatically shown for new objects.

name: auto_show_nonbonded
summary: control whether or not the nonbonded representation is automatically shown for new objects.

name: auto_show_selections
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL automatically enables each new selection.

name: auto_show_spheres
summary: controls whether or not the sphere representation is automatically shown for new objects.

name: auto_zoom
summary: controls automatic zooming behavior: 0 = no zoom 1 = zoom new objects 2 = zoom always 3 = zoom current state always 4 = zoom all objects 5 = zoom first object only

name: autoclose_dialogs
summary: Unused setting.

name: backface_cull
summary: controls whether or not the raytracer renders backfacing triangles.

name: batch_prefix
summary: contains a prefix to be used for temporary files.

name: bg_gradient
summary: Controls whether or not the background is gradient colored. If yes, then bg_rgb_top and bg_rgb_bottom will be used to set the colors.

name: bg_image_filename
summary: if set controls the image used in the background.

name: bg_image_linear
summary: controls the sampling of the texture for the background image. If off, then the nearest pixel is set, otherwise, a linear interpolation is used.

name: bg_image_mode
summary: Determines how the background image is drawn. 0 - stretched, 1 - centered, 2 - tiled, 3 - centered and repeated

name: bg_image_tilesize
summary: This setting is used when bg_image_mode=3 and defines the size of each tile (in x and y, z is not used).

name: bg_rgb
summary: controls the background rgb color.

name: bg_rgb_bottom
summary: Controls bottom color when bg_gradient is set.

name: bg_rgb_top
summary: Controls top color when bg_grdient is set.

name: button_mode
summary: reports the current button mode index (internal).

name: button_mode_name
summary: reports the current button mode name.

name: cache_display
summary: controls whether or not a copy is made of the current display in order to speed updates of menus, etc.

name: cache_frames
summary: controls whether or not each movie frame will be stored in RAM and then replayed from memory. This is used for previewing a movie at a higher frame rate. The \mclear\" command can be used to flush ...

name: cache_max
summary: controls how many primitive data elements can be retained in the geometry cache (before old/unused entries are expired).

name: cache_memory
summary: special case, currently unsupported setting.

name: cache_mode
summary: (integer: 0-2, default 0) controls whether or not PyMOL retains precomputed geometries (such as molecular surfaces) inside the session file. 0: off 1: read only 2: retain all new surfaces computed

name: cartoon_all_alt
summary: If on, cartoon is drawn through all alternate-location atoms rather than just the primary altloc.

name: cartoon_color
summary: (color, default:-1) controls the color of the cartoon representation.

name: cartoon_cylindrical_helices
summary: controls whether helices are displayed as cylinders or as a residue-based cartoon.

name: cartoon_debug
summary: (integer: 0-3, default: 0) is for development.

name: cartoon_discrete_colors
summary: affects whether per-residue colors change at or halfway inbetween the C-alpha position.

name: cartoon_dumbbell_length
summary: is a parameter for the dumbbell cross-section.

name: cartoon_dumbbell_radius
summary: is a parameter for the dumbbell cross-section.

name: cartoon_dumbbell_width
summary: is a parameter for the dumbbell cross-section.

name: cartoon_fancy_helices
summary: controls whether dumbbell or oval cross-section is used.

name: cartoon_fancy_sheets
summary: controls whether or not beta-sheet strands have arrows.

name: cartoon_flat_cycles
summary: is the number of cycles of \flattening\" applied to beta-sheets when cartoon_flat_sheets is on."

name: cartoon_flat_sheets
summary: controls whether or not beta-sheet strands are flattened.

name: cartoon_gap_cutoff
summary: cutoff for drawing a dashed cartoon loop across gaps. E.g. if one residue is missing, the cutoff needs to be >=2 (or for 5 missing residues, >= 6, etc.).

name: cartoon_helix_radius
summary: controls the radius of the cylindrical helix representation.

name: cartoon_highlight_color
summary: controls the accent color.

name: cartoon_ladder_color
summary: controls the color of the ladder representation.

name: cartoon_ladder_mode
summary: controls how the ladder is drawn.

name: cartoon_ladder_radius
summary: controls the radius of the ladder representation.

name: cartoon_loop_cap
summary: (integer: 0-2, default: 1) controls how loop segments are capped: 0 = not capped 1 = round cap 2 = flat cap

name: cartoon_loop_quality
summary: controls how many facets are used to draw the loop cross-section.

name: cartoon_loop_radius
summary: controls the radius of loop segments.

name: cartoon_nucleic_acid_as_cylinders
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL draws cartoon nucleic acids as high-quality cylinders or low-quality.

name: cartoon_nucleic_acid_color
summary: controls the control of nucleic acid backbone cartoons.

name: cartoon_nucleic_acid_mode
summary: controls how the nucleic acid backbone is computed: 0 = use P coordinates 1 = use C1* coordinates 2 = use P coordinates and terminal 3' OH (if present) 3 = use P coordinates and terminal 5' OH (if ...

name: cartoon_oval_length
summary: is the length of the oval cross-section.

name: cartoon_oval_quality
summary: controls how many facets are used to draw the oval cross-section.

name: cartoon_oval_width
summary: is the width of the oval cross section.

name: cartoon_power
summary: affects cartoon shape.

name: cartoon_power_b
summary: affects cartoon shape.

name: cartoon_putty_quality
summary: controls how many facets are used.

name: cartoon_putty_radius
summary: is the default putty size.

name: cartoon_putty_range
summary: is a putty scaling parameter.

name: cartoon_putty_scale_max
summary: is a putty scaling parameter.

name: cartoon_putty_scale_min
summary: is a putty scaling parameter.

name: cartoon_putty_scale_power
summary: is a putty scaling parameter.

name: cartoon_putty_transform
summary: 0 is normalized nonlinear scaling; 1 is relative nonlinear scaling; 2 is scaled nonlinear scaling; 3 is absolute nonlinear scaling; 4 is normalized linear scaling; 5 is relative linear scaling; 6 i...

name: cartoon_rect_length
summary: is the length of the rectangle cross-section.

name: cartoon_rect_width
summary: is the width of the rectangle cross-section.

name: cartoon_refine
summary: controls how much refinement is done of intermediate cartoon coordinates.

name: cartoon_refine_normals
summary: controls whether or not normals are refined (-1 = automatic).

name: cartoon_refine_tips
summary: controls how much the tips of beta-strands are refined (straightened).

name: cartoon_ring_color
summary: controls the color of ring representation.

name: cartoon_ring_finder
summary: Which rings the cartoon ring finder detects: 1 bases+sugars, 2 bases only, 3 non-protein rings, 4 all rings.

name: cartoon_ring_mode
summary: controls how rings are shown: 0 = no ring (use ladders for bases, if applicable) 1 = round-edge rings 2 = square-edge rings 3 = rings with edges 4 = show ring as a sphere of approximate size 5 = sh...

name: cartoon_ring_radius
summary: controls the radius of the sphere used to represent rings (-1.0 means compute from ring geometry).

name: cartoon_ring_transparency
summary: controls the transparency level of rings. When negative, this setting is controlled by cartoon_transparency.

name: cartoon_ring_width
summary: controls the thickness of the ring representation.

name: cartoon_round_helices
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL makes helices round by forcing orientation vectors to point along the helix axes.

name: cartoon_sampling
summary: controls how many facets are used to draw cartoon segments.

name: cartoon_side_chain_helper
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL will hide backbone lines and sticks when the cartoon representation is visible as well as disabling smoothing for C-alpha coordinates for residues whose side chains ar...

name: cartoon_smooth_cycles
summary: controls how many smoothing cycles are applied to the overall cartoon.

name: cartoon_smooth_cylinder_cycles
summary: Number of smoothing passes applied to cylindrical (helix) cartoon axes.

name: cartoon_smooth_cylinder_window
summary: Window size used when smoothing cylindrical (helix) cartoon axes.

name: cartoon_smooth_first
summary: (integer, default: 1) controls the start point for smoothing each segment.

name: cartoon_smooth_last
summary: controls the stop point for smoothing of each segment.

name: cartoon_smooth_loops
summary: controls whether or not loop segments are smoothed. Note that this setting modifies the apparent coordinates of the loop in order to achieve improved aesthetics.

name: cartoon_throw
summary: affects cartoon geometry.

name: cartoon_trace_atoms
summary: controls whether cartoons are traced through all atoms. Note that this setting only works well for the loop and tube representations.

name: cartoon_transparency
summary: controls the transparency of cartoon representations.

name: cartoon_tube_cap
summary: controls the type of cap applied to the tube, and accepts the same values as cartoon_loop_cap.

name: cartoon_tube_quality
summary: controls how many facets are used in the tube cross-section.

name: cartoon_tube_radius
summary: controls the radius of tube segments.

name: cartoon_use_shader
summary: If true, on screen rendering of cartoons uses the OpenGL shader language (GLSL) to render cartoon. If false, OpenGL v1.x style rendering is used.

name: cavity_cull
summary: is the threshold below which isolated clusters of points will be excluded from the surface representation. These are generally interior pockets inside of proteins.

name: cell_centered
summary: If on, the crystallographic unit-cell box is drawn centered on the origin.

name: cell_color
summary: Color of the unit-cell box (-1 = default/object color).

name: cgo_debug
summary: Controls whether or not PyMOL shows debugging graphics related to CGO objects.

name: cgo_dot_radius
summary: if greater than zero, controls the default radius for cgo dots when ray tracing. Otherwise, the radius is computed from cgo_dot_width.

name: cgo_dot_width
summary: controls the width of cgo dots.

name: cgo_ellipsoid_quality
summary: Controls cgo-based representation quality of ellipsoids.

name: cgo_lighting
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL lights CGOs.

name: cgo_line_radius
summary: if greater than zero, controls the default radius for lines when ray tracing. Otherwise, the radius is computed from cgo_line_width;

name: cgo_line_width
summary: is the default line width for cgo geometries.

name: cgo_ray_width_scale
summary: Scale applied to CGO line widths when ray tracing (negative = pixel-width fallback).

name: cgo_shader_ub_color
summary: controls the data size of color data sent to the graphics card. If enabled, unsigned bytes are sent which may be faster and smaller.

name: cgo_shader_ub_flags
summary: controls whether or not unsigned bytes are used in sending data to the graphics card.

name: cgo_shader_ub_normal
summary: controls the data size of normals sent to the graphics card. If enabled, unsigned bytes are sent which may be faster and smaller.

name: cgo_sphere_quality
summary: controls the sphere quality to use when loading CGO representations.

name: cgo_transparency
summary: controls the default transparency of cgo geometries.

name: cgo_use_shader
summary: If true, on screen rendering of CGOs uses the OpenGL shader language (GLSL). If false, OpenGL v1.x style rendering is used.

name: chem_comp_cartn_use
summary: For mmCIF chem_comp: which Cartesian coordinate columns to use.

name: chromadepth
summary: Enables ChromaDepth stereo encoding (color-coded depth) when non-zero.

name: cif_keepinmemory
summary: Experimental feature. Retain parsed CIF file in memory, for pymol.querying.cif_get_array

name: cif_metalc_as_zero_order_bonds
summary: If on, metal-coordination records in mmCIF are imported as zero-order bonds.

name: cif_use_auth
summary: When loading mmCIF files, use 'auth_*' identifiers (if present, fallback to 'label_*' identifiers). Note that 'label_asym_id' is always loaded as the 'segi' identifier (if present).

name: clamp_colors
summary: controls whether or not colors are clamped to the current color table.

name: clean_electro_mode
summary: Electrostatic model used by the clean/geometry-optimization routine.

name: collada_background_box
summary: If on, a background box is included in exported COLLADA (.dae) scenes.

name: collada_export_lighting
summary: If non-zero, light sources are written into exported COLLADA scenes.

name: collada_geometry_mode
summary: Geometry granularity/mode used when exporting COLLADA.

name: colored_feedback
summary: If on, console/feedback text is colorized.

name: cone_quality
summary: controls the number of segments used to draw CGO cones.

name: connect_bonded
summary: controls whether or not bonds can be detected between atoms with explicit bonds in the PDB file.

name: connect_cutoff
summary: affects how close atoms need to be in order for bonds to be created.

name: connect_mode
summary: controls how bonds are detected when PDB files are loaded. 0 = auto-connect and use explicit valences 1 = use explicit valences only 2 = reserved

name: coulomb_cutoff
summary: is the cutoff for coulombic calculations.

name: coulomb_dielectric
summary: is the dielectric for coulombic calculations.

name: coulomb_units_factor
summary: is the conversion factor to give output units (kT/e).

name: dash_as_cylinders
summary: If true, distance measure dashes are drawn as high-quality cylinders instead of lines.

name: dash_color
summary: Controls the color of dashes used to represent distance measures.

name: dash_gap
summary: controls the length of the visible dash.

name: dash_length
summary: controls the separation between dashes.

name: dash_radius
summary: if greater than zero, controls the radius of the dash when ray tracing. Otherwise, the radius is computed from dash_width.

name: dash_round_ends
summary: controls whether or not dashes are rounded on their ends.

name: dash_transparency
summary: Transparency (0-1) of dashed lines such as distance measures.

name: dash_use_shader
summary: If true, on screen rendering of dashes uses the OpenGL shader language (GLSL). If false, OpenGL v1.x style rendering is used.

name: dash_width
summary: controls the width of the lines used to draw dashes.

name: debug_pick
summary: a setting for debugging mouse pick problems.

name: default_2fofc_map_rep
summary: This controls the default map representation when a 2FoFc map is loaded from an MTZ map.

name: default_buster_names
summary: This is the list of valid column names to be sought when autoloading Buster maps.

name: default_fofc_map_rep
summary: This controls the default map representation when a FoFc map is loaded from an MTZ map.

name: default_phenix_names
summary: This is the list of valid column names to be sought when autoloading Phenix maps.

name: default_phenix_no_fill_names
summary: This is the list of valid column names to be sought when autoloading Phenix (no fill) maps.

name: default_refmac_names
summary: This is the list of valid column names to be sought when autoloading Refmac maps.

name: defer_builds_mode
summary: controls when the underlying geometry for molecular representations is generated, as follows: 0: visible geometry for all states of all enabled objects is generated upfront and retained in memory f...

name: defer_updates
summary: If on, scene/geometry updates are deferred (batched) rather than applied immediately.

name: depth_cue
summary: controls whether or not a depth cue fog effect is used.

name: dihedral_color
summary: controls dihedral measurement colors.

name: dihedral_label_position
summary: (float: >0.0, default: 1.2) controls where the dihedral label is drawn.

name: dihedral_size
summary: (float: >0.0, default: 0.6666) controls how far out the dihedral indicator is drawn.

name: direct
summary: (float 0.0-1.0, default: 0.45) is the amount of light being emitted from the camera.

name: display_scale_factor
summary: Integer UI/display scaling factor for high-DPI (HiDPI/Retina) screens.

name: dist_counter
summary: is the counter used when auto-generating measurement object names.

name: distance_exclusion
summary: controls the cutoff of bonds that two atoms must exceed if a distance is to be drawn between them when mode=3 is used as an option to the distance command.

name: dot_as_spheres
summary: If on, dot-surface dots are drawn as small shaded spheres instead of flat points.

name: dot_color
summary: (color, default -1) controls the color of the dot representation. By default, dots assume the color of the associated atom.

name: dot_density
summary: controls the density of dots taken from the surface of a sphere.

name: dot_hydrogens
summary: controls whether or not dots are drawn on hydrogen atoms.

name: dot_lighting
summary: controls whether or not dots are lit based on their associated surface normals. The setting has no effect when ray tracing.

name: dot_mode
summary: Dot-surface generation mode.

name: dot_normals
summary: controls whether or not dots are drawn with normals. This achieves essentially the same effect as dot_lighting, and it too has no effect when ray tracing.

name: dot_radius
summary: if greater than zero, controls the radius of dots. Otherwise, the dot radius is computed from dot_width based on the pixel size of the current viewport.

name: dot_solvent
summary: controls whether we generate dots for the atomic or solvent accessible surface.

name: dot_use_shader
summary: If true, on screen rendering of dots uses the OpenGL shader language (GLSL). If false, OpenGL v1.x style rendering is used.

name: dot_width
summary: controls the dot width in viewport pixels.

name: draw_frames
summary: controls whether or not each movie frame is rendered using the \draw\" command."

name: draw_mode
summary: 0 is the normal OpenGL renderer; 1 is antialised OpenGL; 2 is ray traced without shadows; 3 is ray traced with shadows.

name: dynamic_measures
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL updates measurement objects when incorporated atoms are moved.

name: dynamic_width
summary: controls whether or not PyMOL draws lines thicker for easier viewing.

name: dynamic_width_factor
summary: controls the dynamic width scaling.

name: dynamic_width_max
summary: controls the dynamic width scaling.

name: dynamic_width_min
summary: controls the dynamic width scaling.
